verdict.rationale: Signifyd offers a 'Chargeback Recovery' product and API endpoints to record Chargeback Events and Representment Outcomes, implying some automation of dispute handling, but the evidence never describes automatic compilation of order/delivery/session evidence or submission to issuers without manual work. missing for 10: documentation of automated evidence-bundling logic, explicit 'no manual copy-paste' claims, and details on how order/delivery/session data feed into representment submissions.
